title: Labor: hours, overtime and labor % by store and by day

scenes.note: Labor for the last 30 days, then this workweek's overtime watch (first names, store and hours so far, never pay; who is in overtime and who is close), overtime hours by store, labor % by day with the stores over target in red

seed: Needs demo data whose last day is a Thursday or Friday: the Labor page's 'Overtime this week' is the workweek of the data's last day, and the seed ends data yesterday.
